name: Re:quiem［Shall We Dance?］
source:
This is "Madoromachi", the town closest to the moon. The residents are busy preparing for the once-a-year "Dream Festival". Amidst this, a mysterious transfer student arrives.

Who will you dance with?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8472]NovelGame[/url]]
